newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian stocks correct, upward trend seen intact.
newsitem.headline: Austrian stocks correct, upward trend seen intact.

text.p: Austria's ATX index came under correction on Thursday following a spectacular rally to a record high the day before, but traders said the market's upward trend remains intact.
The ATX index fell 13.13 points, or 0.9 percent, to 1,439.65 with 15 shares lower, five higher, and one unchanged by the close.
"What we saw today was a little interim correction on the way to 1,500 points," said one trader.
"I didn't see a single investor getting out today," said another, adding today's selling was chiefly by traders.
Traders say the firm dollar and a further rally in German stocks should support the Vienna market on its way to 1,500 points.
The leading ATX decliner was EA Generali, down 2.63 percent to 3,369 schillings.

Bucking the overall market was Creditanstalt's preferred shares, up 5.33 percent at 568.9. They were also the most actively traded on turnover of 192,876 lots. Traders said investors were snapping up Creditanstalt ahead of its first-half earnings tomorrow morning.
The broad-based Vienna bourse index lost 3.27 points, or 0.63 percent, to 514.71.
The August ATX future tumbled 19 points to 1,450 on turnover of 1,209 contracts.
